criterion_text: A trusted staging Server–Agent/Session acceptance Case proves scoped image-grant access, resolved Manifest pinning, shared physical EROFS cache/mount and cleanup across at least two consumers and an Agent restart.

verifiers.summary: Tag/Index resolution pins one verified platform Manifest and fails closed before mount

evidence.value: exact SHA c481c226f12dd9d55021ecec4b7344d44a15ff79: a Tag/Index resolved to one pinned platform Manifest with verified Config/EROFS descriptors; incompatible, ambiguous, stale and missing selections failed closed before a mount attempt

verifiers.summary: Shared, resumed and restarted transfers yield one verified payload while pins protect it

evidence.value: exact SHA c481c226f12dd9d55021ecec4b7344d44a15ff79: an interrupted Range transfer kept a resumable partial and never published, a restart adopted only re-hashed bytes, two Manifests shared one payload download and one physical cache file, pins blocked eviction, and two identities on one volume never shared Ready or partial files

verifiers.summary: Two configs of one EROFS layer share one physical mount with independent release

evidence.value: exact SHA c481c226f12dd9d55021ecec4b7344d44a15ff79: two consumers of one EROFS layer acquired the same physical mount, the remaining consumer kept it after one release, and the last release removed it

verifiers.summary: Server grants stay Manifest-scoped and reachability-checked while layers are shared

evidence.value: exact SHA c481c226f12dd9d55021ecec4b7344d44a15ff79: two authorized consumers shared one EROFS layer without sharing authorization, a Session binding recorded and released its resolved Manifest pin, catalog bytes were served only after digest/size verification, and a Manifest create minted reachable-object grants

verifiers.summary: A manifest grant mounts the layer identity and shares one payload

evidence.value: exact SHA c481c226f12dd9d55021ecec4b7344d44a15ff79: the Agent consumed a Manifest grant through the existing authorized blob route, mounted by EROFS layer identity and shared one payload
